description: Run capabilities of Alexandria data providers and return their typed, sourced records: one, or up to ten in one call when a task needs several lookups. Alexandria is Firecrawl's library of data providers across companies, people, jobs, finance and filings, public records and government spending, real estate, places and restaurants, retail and prices, package registries and developer data, news, research, and more. For people and company enrichment or search, use people_company_enrich or people_company_search when they are listed; call a provider here directly only when the user asks for that provider. Each entry of `calls` is {provider, capability, options}: `provider` and `capability` come from firecrawl_search results or alexandria_library_search, and `options` follow the capability's contract, which marks required inputs and any requiresOneOf groups (at least one member per group). Where the contract declares pagination, its fields page through results with the same filters. Returns one result per call, in the same order, in data.alexandria, each with data, records, or an error with a code; one call can fail while the others succeed, and an invalid call returns an error naming the valid options. A result too large to return inline is retained, and nextTool reads it in slices. Billed per executed capability; discovery is free. Some providers require accepted terms; when a response reports a terms requirement, direct the user to the Firecrawl dashboard URL in that response.

calls.description: The capabilities to run, 1-10, each {provider, capability, options}. Results come back in the same order.

capability.description: Capability address as returned by search or discover, e.g. "series/observations".

options.description: Capability options as declared by its contract.

version.description: Optional published workflow version. Omit to use the latest version.

requestId.description: Idempotency key bound to one execution payload. Generated when omitted and returned with the result.

name: alexandria_library_read

outputSchema.description: The results of the Alexandria capabilities that ran, or a pointer to them when they were retained.

data.description: One result per call, in the same order, in `data.alexandria`, each with `data`, `records`, or an `error` with a code.

delivery.description: `retained` when the full result stayed server-side instead of being inlined.

error.description: Error message or error object when the call did not succeed.

estimatedTokens.description: Estimated token cost of the full result.

feedbackRefs.description: Retained results only: `[{provider, capability, feedbackRef}]` per call; pass a ref in `callRatings` of the feedback tool to rate that call.

feedbackTool.description: Pointer to the feedback tool for reporting how this result served the task.

idleTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a retained workspace stays available while idle.

inlineTokenBudget.description: Token budget above which a result is retained rather than inlined.

nextTool.description: A follow-up tool call (`{name, arguments}`) that continues or inspects this result.

responseBytes.description: Size of the full result in bytes.

retryable.description: Whether resending the same request can succeed; set when the API refused before any provider ran.

workspaceId.description: Workspace holding a retained result, for inspection through virtual Bash.
